claim: Back/front relative action-edge dispersion ratio = 6.17 (dev) / 6.27 (ext) / 5.90 (legacy)
key_numbers: 6.17; task bootstrap 95% CI [5.76,7.06]; direction holds 40/40, 39/39, 5/5 tasks
evidence_for_class: Ratio of front vs back layers within the SAME forward pass; then median over per-task ratios; bootstrap resamples tasks.
recheck_result: Cross-checked by moe-token-geometry-0906 §4 which recomputes partial back/front = 6.00, 37/37 tasks same sign, from an independent kernel cache.

claim: Ten action tokens form a 1-D ordered arc; back layers more rigid/ordered/lower-dimensional than front
key_numbers: r(PC1,index) 0.958-0.998; Robinson 630/632; back>front 37/37 dev and 39/39 ext
evidence_for_class: Compares token positions and layers inside one query; per-task unanimity reported.
recheck_result: moe-state-channel-0906/results/controller_probes/probe3_arc_statistics.csv independently reproduces pc1_index_spearman median 0.964-1.000 across 8 layers on 8 external tasks.

claim: Observation/noise sensitivity ratio rises monotonically over the 10 denoising steps, 8/8 layers
key_numbers: L2 0.190->0.740; L12 1.090->2.799; front/back mobility zero-crossing at step 3->4 in BOTH run_ids
evidence_for_class: query-0 identification: same init state / different seed vs same seed / different init state. Comparison is inside one (task, init-state) cell by construction.
recheck_result: moe-state-channel-0906 probe1 reproduces the cross-query ratio range [1.6266, 4.9090] vs claimed [1.6, 4.9].

claim: state_action_alignment and conditional_energy are one quantity (monotone transform)
key_numbers: dependence ratio 1253; all external metrics bit-identical (37/12 per_task, 33/8 global)
evidence_for_class: Algebraic identity conditional_energy = 1 - mean_t(c_t^2), verified numerically.
recheck_result: moe-state-channel-0906 formation_summary.json identity_check max_abs_error 2.54e-08. Circuit redundancy table shows rho_conditional_energy = -rho_state_action_alignment to 7 digits for every one of 31 circuit features.

claim: mob_ratio (mobility relative to the rollout own q1-q4 baseline) separates true from false alarms; the aggregated score z_F does not
key_numbers: true 0.370-0.386 vs false 0.476-0.477; z_F true 0.627 vs false 0.625 (chunk 20-31)
evidence_for_class: mob_ratio normalised to the rollout own prefix; cannot be a cross-task confound.
recheck_result: Quoted from report, not independently verified.

claim: The conditional kernel is PSD on all 4,015,816 (layer,query) cells; Foster residual equals k-1 exactly on the 16 disconnected cells
key_numbers: min eigenvalue >= 4.52e-6; Foster |residual| <= 1.44e-12; negative off-diagonal mass 4.7e-7
evidence_for_class: Numerical identity per cell. No cross-episode comparison.
recheck_result: Structural, not a discrimination claim.

claim: norm_fiedler is the second strongest single MoE quantity in the project by survival-conditioned AUC
key_numbers: external L12 AUC 0.5969, |AUC-0.5| = 0.0969; beats partial_edge_std 0.0847
evidence_for_class: Metric explicitly defined as strata = (suite, chunk q).
recheck_result: Reproduced 0.5969 exactly. Swapping strata to task: AUC 0.5338, |AUC-0.5| = 0.0338 -> 65% shrinkage. Still the largest task-stratified effect among the 33 circuit quantities, but no longer near-headline.

claim: Risk = collapse toward the uniform clique; 7/7 scale-free clique invariants agree in direction
key_numbers: norm_fiedler 0.5969, gap_ratio 0.5780, kirchhoff_efficiency 0.5764, spectral_erank 0.5760, res_cv 0.4267, th_cv 0.4311, thalt_cv 0.4371
evidence_for_class: Same (suite, chunk) metric as S07.
recheck_result: Reproduced all values exactly. Under task strata: gap_ratio 0.4877, spectral_erank 0.4853, kirchhoff_efficiency 0.4856, res_cv 0.5158, th_cv 0.5268. SIX OF THE SEVEN FLIP SIGN (only norm_fiedler keeps its sign, 0.5969->0.5338); thalt_cv 0.4371->0.5207; median |AUC-0.5| falls 0.0764 -> 0.0147 (81% shrinkage). The 7/7 agreement is a suite-level artefact.

claim: mobility is the strongest single MoE quantity by survival-conditioned AUC (L14 0.3853)
key_numbers: |AUC-0.5| = 0.1147 external, 0.0760 development
evidence_for_class: Same (suite, chunk) metric.
recheck_result: moe-token-geometry-0906 own within-task table gives mobility mean |AUC-0.5| = 0.0380 (L13, chunks 8-24) vs pooled 0.1067 -- 64% shrinkage, computed by the geometry bundle itself but never compared against the circuit bundle number.

claim: Survival prior alone recovers 60.6% of v7 guard accuracy; MoE routing adds 24 points, not 84.6
key_numbers: all: 519 alarms, accuracy 0.846, matched prior 0.606, lift 1.40x; libero_spatial lift 0.998x
evidence_for_class: Survival prior computed per suite ("查同 suite 的存活先验"), not per task.
recheck_result: Direction is certainly right and the report is candid. A per-TASK survival prior would absorb more, so 60.6% is a LOWER bound on the base-rate share.

claim: v7 degrades under leave-one-suite-out; the damage is calibration-corpus horizon composition, not unseen task identity
key_numbers: micro 439/80 -> 414/115; recall -7.60pp macro; freeze threshold swing 44.5pp across folds
evidence_for_class: 4 suite folds. LOSO/LOTO stratify the CALIBRATION CORPUS, not the evaluation comparison.
recheck_result: The mechanism (episode length) is demonstrated at suite granularity only.

claim: All five Stage-1 layer rules have lift in the narrow band 1.39-1.47 despite precision spanning 0.737-0.872
evidence_for_class: Lift is defined against the per-suite survival prior.
recheck_result: This claim is deflationary; a task-level prior would only shrink the lifts further, strengthening it.

claim: Late-success episodes stay quiet right after the alarm and only re-respond near the deadline (offset AUC curve)
evidence_for_class: Ranks 409 episodes pooled across 39 tasks and 4 suites. Row bootstrap, not task bootstrap. Report itself warns trajectory counts differ per offset.
recheck_result: THIS IS THE MONOTONE-DECAY FAMILY. The controller already found the analogous effect goes 0.32-0.40 -> 0.49-0.53 under task stratification. +8 is already 0.514 and the horizon CI lower bound is 0.523, both inside the collapsed band. Only 27 positives; a task-stratified version is likely to be unresolvable at this n.

claim: Frame survey operating points: mobility|L12|global 195/17 lift 1.764 is the best global detector
key_numbers: 195 TP / 17 FP, precision 0.9198, lift 1.7640674; expert_load|L3|per_task 370/93 lift 1.5479
evidence_for_class: global removes task identity from the THRESHOLD only. TP/FP/precision/lift are still pooled over 39 tasks against a per-suite prior.
recheck_result: Operating points reproduce exactly in 6 bundles. But the underlying discrimination is untested within task: the same quantity family loses 65-100% of its threshold-free effect under task strata (see S07/S08).

claim: mobility and flow_settling are near-orthogonal reference frames; their AND gives 187 TP / 8 FP
key_numbers: low-prior overlap 40 of 72+83; common false alarms only 2; AND external 187/8 precision 0.959
evidence_for_class: Pooled across tasks; and FRAME_SURVEY §4 shows the independence-expected co-occurrence is < 1 alarm, so "2 in common" is not evidence.
recheck_result: Self-undermined twice inside its own bundle: (a) FLOW_AXIS blockquote retracts flow_settling (83 early TP -> 3 TP under a global threshold); (b) FRAME_SURVEY §4 says all pairwise dependence ratios are >> 1 and that zeros are noise. The report carve-out "其余结论不受影响" is unsupported.

claim: Geometry quantities lose to the published baselines as alarms; this is not a selection-rule artefact
key_numbers: best global procrustes_prev 61/10 lift 1.755 vs mobility 195/17 lift 1.764; dev ceiling per_task 244 vs 355
evidence_for_class: Alarm counts pooled across tasks.
recheck_result: Negative result; task confounding would not rescue it.

claim: Uniform strict calibration + OR strictly dominates the best single global detector (G-A 288/13 vs mobility 195/17)
key_numbers: G-A 288 TP / 13 FP lift 1.338; G-B 308/23 lift 1.372; the win is cross-suite union coverage (mobility|global is 0/140 on libero_spatial)
evidence_for_class: Selection on development, evaluation pooled. The mechanism is explicitly identified as SUITE coverage, and never tested at task level.
recheck_result: The bundle names its own confound: the gain is that mobility misses one whole suite. Whether the residual gain survives task stratification is untested. Note lift FALLS 1.764 -> 1.338 while TP rises.

claim: Per-detector failure-mode specialisation is largely a task confound
key_numbers: suite strata 20/261 significant; task strata 2/261; MDE smaller under task strata (0.020-0.033 vs 0.029-0.046); dropped 89% task-level
evidence_for_class: Explicit within-stratum permutation nulls at both levels, 20,000 permutations, BH q=0.05.
recheck_result: This is the finding that motivated the audit. It is the only bundle that ran the test.

claim: The one robust axis is reference frame (global vs per_task) -> stable_grasp_not_observed, not routing quantity -> mode
key_numbers: no_grasp: 12/12 paired sign agreement, exact p = 0.00049 external; dedup 11/11 p = 0.00098; dev 7/12 p = 0.033
evidence_for_class: Paired sign-flip permutation on task-stratified expectations.
recheck_result: Survives task stratification. But §2.3 shows it produces NO early warning (no_grasp early recall 0.035 for both global and per_task mobility).

claim: Non-terminal denoising steps carry detection signal the terminal step misses
key_numbers: per_task step 4: 344/61 recall 0.610 vs step 9 272/57 recall 0.482; step 0 catches 96 risks step 9 misses for 29 extra FP; mobility_step_range global 226/20 lift 1.626
evidence_for_class: Pooled alarm counts.
recheck_result: The added coverage could be the same suite-coverage mechanism as S17. Untested at task level. Note lift again FALLS (1.764 -> 1.626) as recall rises.

claim: v7 intrinsic guard: 439 TP / 80 FP, recall 77.84%, precision 84.59%, task-agnostic at runtime
key_numbers: 439/80; early-4 58.69%; timely FPR 0.532%; median lead 12
evidence_for_class: Pooled over 39 tasks. LOTO §3.2 gives the task-equal-weighted counterpart.
recheck_result: LOTO §3.2 macro over 39 tasks: recall 72.30% / precision 78.14% vs pooled 77.84% / 84.59%. Task equal-weighting costs -5.54pp recall and -6.45pp precision -- the same magnitude as the whole LOSO degradation the bundle treats as its headline. The bundle demotes this number to "reference only".

claim: Requiring 8 chunks of intervention budget drops recall 77.84% -> 44.50%; only libero_long supports real lead time
key_numbers: B=8: 251/74, recall 44.50%, precision 77.23%; libero_spatial B=8 recall 0.00%
evidence_for_class: Per-suite breakdown; horizon cap H is a per-suite constant.
recheck_result: Horizon-cap premise independently verified here: all 564 external risks have length exactly = suite cap (see recheck_meta.json).

claim: Pre-failure geometric deformation: bandedness down, size up, procrustes_layer up, 8/8 chunks consistent
key_numbers: bandedness L5 AUC 0.361-0.449 mean |d| 0.086; size L4 0.538-0.626 mean |d| 0.076; mobility anchor mean |d| 0.038
evidence_for_class: Within-task AUC among episodes still running at chunk q. Verified: my recomputation matches all 288 published cells to < 2e-3.
recheck_result: Genuinely task-stratified. This is the strongest task-robust effect in the whole corpus and the reports do not say so, because the geometry bundle only compared itself to alarm performance.
